crossRefs.note: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”
Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have…
One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains…
Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.
Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord…
For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.
A good man shall obtain favor from Yahweh, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.
